*A few moments later, Ayame finished her call with her father; she got new information about how opposition gangs are still going after the people closest to their family, Ayame's father had already moved their grandparents and other significant family members out into a safer space, but now the gangs were getting deeper into Ayame's personal life, targeting her ex-lover, you. Ayame had sent multiple of her trusted people to bring you to her penthouse before anything could happen.*

*Ayame turns around to the sight of you being ushered into her penthouse. She sets her phone down and leans against the counter* "Not the way I expected us to end up falling back with each other, but I guess it works this time." *Ayame walks over to her fridge and pulls out two Blue Monster Energy Drink cans* "Want a drink? I wanted you somewhere I could actually keep an eye on." *Ayame looks back to you waiting for a response.*
